description: A comprehensive library of form controls for Blazor applications, providing consistent, feature-rich input components with built-in validation, accessibility support, and flexible styling options.
releaseNotes: 10.7.1 - Breaking: the AntD-style calendar-dropdown date control, formerly EditDatePicker<T>, is renamed to EditDate<T> and is now the default date control -- the previous native-input EditDate<T> is renamed to EditDateNative<T>. A compile-time-obsolete EditDatePicker<T> stub catches stale `<EditDatePicker>` markup with a build error, but a bare existing `<EditDate>` reference that meant the native input still compiles -- it silently renders the calendar dropdown instead; audit every EditDate usage before upgrading and switch to EditDateNative if you need the old native-input behavior. The new EditDate also needs wss-controls.css and the lazily-imported wss-picker.js (previously only edit-controls.css), so an app linking just edit-controls.css now renders an unstyled date field with no dropdown. Narrower breaks alongside it: INotificationService.Success/Info/Warning/Error now return Guid instead of void (pass it to Remove to dismiss a sticky notification programmatically) -- a source break only for a custom INotificationService implementation; ReadOnlyValue.IsLabelHidden is replaced by HasLabelElement (inverted meaning); the always-inert FormLabel.IdPrefix and FieldValidationDisplay.IdPrefix are removed; WasmMessageContainer/WasmNotificationContainer now throw on Blazor Server (including InteractiveAuto's server phase) instead of silently leaking one user's toasts to every circuit -- switch to the scoped IMessageService/INotificationService path if this fires; EditDateRange.FieldCssClass changes from a protected property to a protected method (affects only an out-of-repo subclass, none known); and both the password and read-only-mask reveal toggles now keep a constant accessible name with aria-pressed carrying the state, instead of a name that flips with the state -- a Playwright/test-selector break only, not a runtime one. Security: EditString's read-only link mode now mirrors the browser's own URL preprocessing before checking scheme, closing two javascript: bypasses (an embedded tab/CR/LF, a leading C0 control byte) and rejecting a protocol-relative URL (//host/path) that used to resolve cross-origin; rel="noopener noreferrer" now covers every UrlTarget except _self/_parent/_top, not just _blank, closing a reverse-tabnabbing gap on named targets (a test asserting no rel on a named target needs updating). Read-only password/masked fields no longer disclose their value: a disabled field's toggle can no longer reveal it, the reveal state no longer survives a read-only round trip, an IsPassword flip, or a swapped bound record, an all-whitespace MaskText now masks instead of silently printing the raw value, and FormOptions.ShowBoundValues now redacts password fields instead of echoing them. New (Edit Controls): EditDate<T> gains Size (SelectSize, wss-picker-sm/lg) and ParsingErrorMessage (default "The {0} field must be a date.", surfaced via its own ValidationMessageStore when typed text isn't a date at all) -- both added to the picker before the rename above, so EditDate is a genuine superset of the old EditDatePicker, not a regression; EditDate deliberately has no UpdateOn (a picker commits on selection/parse, not per keystroke -- use EditDateNative for that axis); UpdateTrigger enum + UpdateOn parameter (plus FormDefaults.UpdateOn) to choose commit-on-keystroke vs. commit-on-blur/Enter for EditString/EditTextArea/EditNumber/EditDateNative/the Radio "Other" box; six new model attributes ([Placeholder], [MinValue]/[MaxValue], [Autocomplete], [Step], [BoolText], [Rows], [FileConstraints]) so field-semantic markup can live on the model instead of every call site, honored with a uniform precedence (markup parameter -> model attribute -> DataAnnotations fallback -> control default) across every scalar and date control. New (UI Kit): DatePicker/DateRangePicker gain Size (SelectSize, wss-picker-sm/lg), the same parameter EditDate forwards; Select.AriaErrorMessage, forwarded by EditSelectSearch/EditMultiSelect, plus aria-errormessage on EditFile; a new Select.AdditionalAttributes splat (previously an unmatched attribute on <Select> threw); Table gains eight localizable label parameters covering its last hardcoded English strings (selection checkboxes, pagers, sort/filter buttons). Changed: default checkbox/radio label spacing now matches AntD's 8px flex-row gap for every EditBool/EditCheckedStringList/EditCheckedEnumList/EditRadioString/EditRadioEnum/EditRadio label, not just the UseStyledCheckbox variant -- a visible default-rendering change for every consumer; EditSelectSearch.Placeholder/EditMultiSelect.Placeholder are now string? (previously string, defaulted to "Please select"); unmatched attributes (inputmode, readonly, spellcheck, data-*, title, extra aria-*) on any scalar Edit* control now actually render instead of being silently swallowed, landing on the field element (or .edit-control-wrapper for style) -- a control with no extra attributes still renders byte-identical markup; a runtime Id/IdPrefix change now re-targets the whole control (FormLabel's for, aria-describedby/errormessage, FormOptions registration) instead of leaving it wired to its original id; EditString/EditTextArea's Clear() now writes an empty string instead of null, matching manual deletion and closing a HidingMode.WhenNull clear-and-unmount trap. Fixed: a large internal multi-round audit landed dozens more accessibility, correctness and DRY fixes across the whole library -- highlights: Tabs keeps its declared tab order and keyboard focus across conditional insertion/removal; Table column order no longer drifts on sort/filter/paging, filter-pruned values no longer filter invisibly, and a runtime column-parameter change now actually re-renders; both date pickers enforce Disabled while their panel is open, drop half-typed text on an external value change, and no longer crash on Mode="Week" near DateTime's own range limits; EditFile's upload-rejection messages and hover state no longer outlive their upload or survive going disabled; EditRadioEnum's preserved "Other" text no longer leaks onto a swapped bound record; an empty EditDisplay no longer collapses to zero height; RTL logical-property and prefers-reduced-motion coverage extended across both stylesheets; several WCAG 1.4.3/1.4.11 contrast and 2.5.8 hit-target fixes; the new flex checkbox/radio labels are hardened against a consumer's own input flex/margin resets; EditSelectEnum ports EditSelectString's no-JS selected-option fallback for prerender/no-JS rendering; the Select engine's value-to-label lookup is unified across Select/EditSelectSearch/EditMultiSelect, fixing label drift on a duplicate-valued option list; SearchInput's clear/search buttons no longer collapse under a consumer's button height reset; the JS overlay positioning helpers are consolidated, fixing inconsistent dropdown/panel flip-to-fit behavior. See the README changelog for the complete list. Internal: extensive DRY/refactoring passes (shared control-base classes, JS module and overlay-positioning consolidation, CSS token consolidation, hoisted e2e scaffolding) and dependency/test-infra bumps (ASP.NET Core Components, bUnit 2.x, Playwright) -- no consumer-facing API or behavior change beyond what's called out above.
title: Blazor Controls
